invention.ref: Jacob Perkins built the first working vapor-compression refrigeration system in London

patent.ref: British patent 6662 granted to Jacob Perkins for ice making and cooling fluids
patent.ref_zh: 珀金斯获得英国第6662号制冷与造冰专利

mass_production.ref: Fred W. Wolf Jr. introduced the DOMELRE (Domestic Electric Refrigerator) in Chicago
mass_production.ref_zh: 沃尔夫在芝加哥推出首个一体化家用电机组 DOMELRE

popularization.ref: General Electric introduced the Monitor-Top refrigerator, popularizing hermetic home refrigeration
popularization.ref_zh: 通用电气推出顶部密封压缩机 Monitor-Top 冰箱，推动家用普及

sources.title: General Electric Monitor Top Refrigerator, 1927 — National Museum of American History

summary_zh: 冰箱通过人工制冷保持低温以储藏食品。19世纪确立蒸气压缩循环后，20世纪初走向家庭化，通用电气1927年推出的密闭压缩机机型带动了现代家用冰箱的普及。
summary_en: The refrigerator preserves food by artificial cooling. Following 19th-century vapor-compression systems, General Electric's 1927 Monitor-Top popularized sealed home refrigeration.
